messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PAGER fired for routing-high-5xx-rate (service: routing-proxy-us-east). Severity: P1. Trigger: 5xx rate > 5% for 5m in us-east-az12. PD incident: INC1769876543 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident INC1769876543 created -> paging alex.sre -> escalation to oncall group in 2m if not ACKed
alex.sre: acked. seeing immediate spike in 503s from az12, looks like connection churn to the kube nodes behind proxy pool A.
maria-netops: I'm seeing NIC errors on several hosts in az12 from fabric telemetry, RX drops and link flaps. forwarding fabric logs to thread.
ben-oncall: adding quick customer-impact note: Dedicated customers on us-east region may see elevated latencies and intermittent 503s; hosted api hitting failover path for some requests.
lina-cs: notified top 3 affected customers (acme, buildly, notesly). They're seeing model calls erroring. customers asking ETA.
sam-platform: running targeted health check across pools, will attempt traffic divert to az11/az3 if health checks consistent.
alex.sre: quick probes:
```
# curl health of routing-proxy
curl -svS https://us-east.az12.routing.redwood.internal/health
* Connected to ...
< HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
{"status":"degraded","errors":42}
```

maria-netops: fabric shows intermittent NIC flaps timed around 1769876480-1769876520 on switches s-us-east-az12-3/4. Ops team running NIC firmware rollback on one host to test.
ben-oncall: can we mute PD escalation loop? it's firing repeat pages as services retry. PD escalation noise is drowning actual work.
incident-bot: Auto-suppressing repeated paging for INC1769876543 for 10m per autopager policy (reasons: throttle, active mitigation in progress).
alex.sre: plan: 1) enable regional routing divert for traffic bound to az12 -> az3 for low-latency routes; 2) scale up fallback pool in az3 for dedicated customers; 3) coordinate with netops for NIC mitigation. Starting divert now (will do canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%).
sam-platform: executing divert commands, posting logs:
```
# routing control CLI
redwood-routectl divert --from us-east-az12 --to us-east-az3 --scope routing-proxy --percent 5
# result
{"status":"ok","divert_id":"divert-1769876543-a"}
```

maria-netops: netops confirmed rollback helped one host, but still 3 hosts flapping. if divert completes we should reduce customer impact.
ben-oncall: started notifying buildly about divert and planned full failover if issues persist. they asked for timeline and mitigation steps. sent update.
alex.sre: raising canary to 25% now.
```
redwood-routectl status divert-1769876543-a
{"percent":25,"healthy":true,"errors_per_min":1}
```

lina-cs: acme says they're still seeing errors for long prompts, but volume down. asked them to retry, they're tolerant for now.
pagerduty: note: escalation to SRE lead if not resolved in 30m.
ben-oncall: taking L2 handoff from alex in 10m, will remain primary for next shift. alex, post handoff checklist when you leave.
alex.sre: checklist: 1) divert id and rollback steps in case divert worsens 2) netops contact + switch ids 3) PD/CS templates for customer comms. posting templates below.
```
PD template: "We are investigating increased 5xx rates in us-east-az12. Traffic is being diverted; mitigations in progress. No data loss. Expected next update in 15 minutes."
CS template: "We're currently diverting traffic off the affected AZ to reduce errors; you may see transient retries. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."
```

sam-platform: divert at 100% now. verifying routing metrics.
```
# metrics snapshot
us-east-az12: 5xx_rate=0.7% (down from 6.2%)
us-east-az3: latency +5ms, capacity headroom OK
```

maria-netops: fabric still noisy, but impact on customer-facing errors reduced. continuing host remediation.
ben-oncall: marking customer impact level: partial outage for az12 -> mitigated by divert. moving to P1-maintain until netops resolves flaps.
lina-cs: customers updated. acme requested a conference bridge, scheduled at :phone: now with oncall + netops.
alex.sre: starting postmortem doc stub in ops/incident/INC1769876543. include timeline + root cause hypothesis (fabric NIC firmware regression).
incident-bot: PD note: INC1769876543 status changed to "mitigated" by alex.sre. Auto-close conditions: no 5xx spike for 30m after divert rollback.
pagerduty: incident status updated -> mitigated. No further escalations will be sent unless threshold re-triggers.
ben-oncall: I'll stay on the bridge until netops confirms stable links and we'll coordinate rollback of divert once safe.
sam-platform: follow ups: add diversion automation test to canary suite, add new alert to detect repeated PD loops, and record metrics about divert latency overhead.
alex.sre: leaving now, handoff complete to ben-oncall. good job team :thumbsup:
lina-cs: will compile customer notes and share postmortem-ready update after the RCA.
ben-oncall: closing thread here but will append final timeline when we finish.
incident-bot: This thread will be archived once the incident is resolved."
